name: Vicious Frizzen
description: Snap the pistol from the hip to the mark in a short rising hop and fire before the arm stills.

name: Raw Muzzle
description: Fire with the eyes on the foe and not the sight, the first finger laid along the barrel as a guide.

name: Lithe Pointblank
description: Duck under a swing as the pistol clears the belt and rise on the opposite side of the foe.

name: Hammerhasp
description: Brace the wrist against the hip and let the barrel's iron meet a thrust coming in low.

name: Muzzleflog
description: Push qi into the draw so two snap shots leave the pistol almost as one report.

name: Dire Barrel
description: Let the barrel follow the eyes through a running foe's turns and fire at his first still moment.

name: Barrelscorer
description: Settle the pistol hand against the saddle horn to steady the shot from a walking mount.

name: Rude Quickdraw
description: Loop the reins on the off hand and draw the pistol free without checking the mount.

name: Bold Thumbback
description: Reach to the saddle holster pipe, thumb the cap back and clear the pistol in one stroke.

name: Muzzleswerve
description: Rise in the stirrups and lean to shift the body's line while the mount runs on.

name: Buttressed Flashpan
description: Crouch low along the mount's neck so the horse's body covers the rider's chest.

name: Pistolscorer
description: Swing out of the saddle and fire the instant the boots strike the ground.

name: Barrelswat
description: At a canter, time the shot to the moment all hooves leave the ground, steadied by a pulse of qi.

name: Cramping Foresight
description: Lay a calm qi through the knees to keep the mount from bolting at the report.

name: Hammer Zip
description: Turn the body edge-on to the foe so the chest presents the narrowest mark.

name: Pistoltonic
description: Hold the pistol upright by the cheek while counting the foe's steps, reading the moment he will break.

name: Report Swat
description: Drop the raised arm straight down onto the mark and fire the moment the barrel levels.

name: Dire Cylinder
description: Tuck the free hand behind the back so no flailing arm disturbs the aim, then fire.

name: Guarding Lanyardring
description: Swat the foe's barrel aside with the flat of the free hand as he fires at close pace.

name: Savage Report
description: Hold the breath and a thread of qi in the arm until the foe's pistol drops, then answer in one report.

name: Pistolglide
description: Step a half pace aside as the foe fires, so his ball passes the empty air where the chest was.

name: Regimen Pistolgrip
description: Wind the cloak round the off forearm and take a blade's cut on the thick folds.

name: Cramping Snapfire
description: Whirl the cloak across the foe's face while the pistol rises unseen beneath it.

name: Quickdraw Flog
description: Draw the pistol from under the folds of the cloak so the foe never sees the hand move.

name: Grit Lanyardring
description: Gather the hem in the free hand and take a long step without tangling the feet.

name: Comet Triggerbar
description: Push the muzzle through a fold of the cloak and fire from behind cloth at the foe's body.

name: Buttressed Muzzle
description: Shrug off a cloak smoking from muzzle flash before it can catch, without breaking the aim.

name: Barrelprop
description: Pour qi into the heavy wool so the swung cloak stiffens and turns a thrust aside.

name: Regimen Frizzen
description: Sweep the cloaked pistol arm across a crowded room and fire at the one foe who steps out.

name: Gleam Barrel
description: Step back wrapped in the cloak and fire under its edge as the foe commits to the chase.

name: Snapfire Curl
description: Set the pistol hand forward and the hanger hand back so each weapon keeps its own line.

name: Hammerslap
description: Fire the pistol at the first step of an advance and draw the hanger as the smoke clears.

name: Resolute Cylinder
description: Cross the hanger's edge over the pistol barrel to catch a cut aimed at both hands.

name: Shielding Pistolgrip
description: Tuck the pistol arm beneath the hanger's guard and hold the line against a two-handed blow.

name: Hipshot Thwack
description: Strike with the hanger's pommel, then rest the barrel on the same fist and fire from the lowered guard.

name: Draught Hammer
description: Let the hanger fall on its wrist loop and fire the pistol at the foe who steps into the gap.

name: Clayhammer
description: Pivot on the back foot after the shot, cutting a short arc with the hanger to clear a path.

name: Brass Foresight
description: Close through the powder smoke with the hanger low and drive the point under the foe's guard.

name: Gallhammer
description: Cross both weapons before the foe's chest, pin his blade between them and force it aside.

name: Crimson Thumbback
description: Run a line of qi along the hanger and flip the pistol to club grip in the same step.

name: Grim Triggerbar
description: Lead with the muzzle round each turn of a stair, never letting the body appear before the barrel.

name: Clay Thumbback
description: Count the stairs down by ear so the feet meet each tread without a glance.

name: Sprig Cylinder
description: Slide along the wall with one shoulder against it so the foe has only a narrow mark.

name: Shard Lanyardring
description: Fire from a crouch on the landing, under the rail where the foe will not look.

name: Lunar Flashpan
description: Test a latch with the muzzle's tip, feeling for the pressure of a body leaning on the far side.

name: Hipshot Swerve
description: Gather a thin qi underfoot so old boards bear the weight without a creak.

name: Pointblank Slap
description: Fire a ball along the stone so it rings off the walls and drives foes back to the far end.

name: Scudding Flashpan
description: Plant the feet wide and bend the knees to ride the roll of the deck under the pistol.

name: Barrelflog
description: Hook the free elbow round a rail and fire from the steadied arm as the ship comes level.

name: Hammerflog
description: Time the shot to the top of the swell, when the deck hangs still for an instant.

name: Pistolscreen
description: Cup the hand over the pan to keep the spray from wetting the priming.

name: Dense Hammer
description: Duck beneath a swinging line and hook it aside with the barrel as the boarder comes down it.

name: Doughty Muzzle
description: Rest the barrel on the lip of a hatch and take a patient shot at a foe across the deck.

name: Pistolbarrier
description: Root a thread of qi through the soles into the planks so a lurch cannot throw the aim.

name: Report Flog
description: Fan the muzzle along the rail as boarders climb, firing to hold the foremost back.

name: Hungry Barrel
description: Run a wet rag down the barrel to scour the fouling before it chokes the next ball.

name: Pistolbandage
description: Strike the flint against the frizzen to hear whether the edge is dull, then swap it in two breaths.

name: Quickening Triggerbar
description: Tilt the muzzle and listen for the ball's shift to know whether it has seated.

name: Keen Pistolgrip
description: Thumb the mainspring's tension at full cock and fire only if it holds firm.

name: Lurching Foresight
description: Clear a blocked vent with the needle wire while the muzzle stays trained on the foe's feet.

name: Savage Quickdraw
description: Push a pulse of qi up the choked barrel to loosen the fouling enough for one last shot.

name: Sprighammer
description: Tip the hat brim over the lock to turn rain from the pan as the arm rises.

name: Sprig Barrel
description: Wrap the lock in oiled cloth and tear it away only at the moment of the draw.

name: Candormuzzle
description: Aim at the foe's footfalls through thick fog and hold fire until the sound is close.

name: Snapfire Zip
description: Shift weight onto the flat of the foot so wet stones cannot throw the stance.

name: Shard Frizzen
description: Draw a cartridge from inside the coat and load without letting a drop reach the powder.

name: Staticbarrel
description: Dab the front sight dry with a thumb and fire before the mist clouds it again.

name: Lanyardring Prop
description: Warm the pan cover with a bright thread of qi so rain hisses away before it reaches the priming.

name: Discord Cylinder
description: Fire a shot to the left into the fog so the report draws foes while the shooter slips right.

name: Barrelzip
description: Move on the beats of the heaviest downpour so footfalls vanish beneath its roar.
